Northern Navigation Co. (Canada Steamship Lines), midsummer schedule: westbound from Windsor Fridays June 25 - Sept. 3, eastbound from Duluth Tuesdays June 29 - Sept. 7; one round trip a week. Times printed in Eastern Standard Time (Duluth in Central) and shown here in Pacific time, three hours earlier. The Detroit call is printed on one side only (westbound leaving 11.00 p.m., eastbound arriving 3.30 p.m.): the other side is estimated.
